name: Prudential Singapore
summary: Established insurer with health and protection plans commonly sold to residents, including post-PR hospital top-ups.
body: Work with an adviser who will put exclusions in writing. EP-year foreigner hospital plans and post-PR Integrated Shield Plans are different products — do not assume MediSave funding until you are SC/PR on MediShield Life. If you may leave Singapore in 2–3 years, ask about portability and surrender paths before you buy.
